## 3. Where New Content Would Live

Could be lengthened or split into a lay-intuition paragraph + technical paragraph; pure JS-object edit, no generator change. The developer guide (py:99-138, step 4) already documents this as the registration point.

**(b) Perfect-vs-Critical explanation.** Currently buried in the "How scoring works" collapsible (L536-558) and repeated in toggle tooltips (L1423-1431, L1597-1600). Promoting it to an always-visible block (out of `<details>`) or a dedicated About subsection is a pure-template edit. The leaderboard lead (L609-618) and metric-note (L1429-1431) would need consistent rewording.

**(c) Key-takeaways editorial near the top.** No slot exists today — the hero verdict (L457, `renderHero` L1181-1236) is deliberately 100% computed ("no hand-written numbers", L1178). Options: (i) a new static section between `#hero` and `#about`; (ii) a new placeholder token (e.g. `__EDITORIAL_HTML__`) filled by the generator. The substitution mechanism (`generate_html` py:1370-1396, `str.replace` on unique tokens, data bundle substituted last) supports new tokens trivially. **A new section additionally requires:** a TOC link (L436-448), the `SECTION_IDS` array (L2832), `sectionRenderers` only if JS-rendered (L2797-2805), and the `content-visibility` CSS list (L78-84) if below the fold. So yes — the mechanism supports clean additions, with four registration points to touch.

**Explains today:** (intro, ~180 words) what is measured — behavioral conformance, not intelligence — and the Claude-tuning confound; (phases collapsible) the five phases, checkpoint mechanics, composite membership/partial-data rules; (scoring) deterministic scorers, Perfect vs Critical/Normal with a 12-run worked example; (execution) real container, `claude -p`, reps, archived result sets; (caveats) six honest limitations.

- Definitions of orchestrator, subagent, skill, hook, engagement mode, confirmation gate — used in the intro before any definition.
- The run/case/rep taxonomy in plain language (counts appear at L490-521 but "rep" first defined in the execution collapsible).

- **Axis/legend labels**: "Blended 3:1", log-scale price axis, "efficiency frontier (outlined points)" (L1693-1698, L2705) — the "↖ best value" annotation (L2709) is the only lay aid.
